content.title: Launch Schedule, Viewing Venues, "Launches" App - American Space Museum & Walk of Fame Titusville FL
content.text: One of the Space Coast’s most unique attractions is rocket launch viewing from Titusville’s Space View Park. Directly across the river from Kennedy Space Center, this unique riverfront park gives you a great unobstructed view of launches while surrounded by monuments to space history. Park MAP Get parked then while waiting for the launch …OR… for traffic to clear after the launch… Explore the park’s monuments honoring those who made the U.S. space programs possible. Our American Space Museum is walking distance from Space View Park and includes a gift shop. Museum Hours & Location See, hear and FEEL one of the most dramatic events on earth! Photographers often capture stunning photos by including launch reflections from the river. Night reflections are especially awesome. Local Things To Do Hotels & Lodging in the Area Other Launch Viewing Venues Can’t make it to Space View Park? Here is a map of on the Space Coast including… Launch Pad Locations Suggested Viewing Sites Dine with a View Hotels with Great Views Boat Ramps Boat and Kayak Launch Viewing Tours Space Coast Launches App The Space Coast Launches App is available from Google or Apple to watch a live stream of launches from Kennedy Space Center & Cape Canaveral. Locate the exact spot on the horizon to watch during a live rocket launch using the Compass feature. Countdown every second with real-time launch clock on the main screen. Keep track of upcoming missions including current launch schedule, in-depth mission plans and rocket details. App courtesy of Space Coast Florida
